specialisation: fast, cost-effective general language generation with agent task execution, tool orchestration and image understanding
fit_note: Vendor-stated strengths (agent task execution, tool orchestration) are the workload this arena measures, so a weak cell is more readily attributable to the framework than to model mismatch. Every board published in this repository before 2026-07-27 ran on this model.

reasoning_mode.note: No separate thinking/reasoning mode is documented for this model, so there is no uncontrolled reasoning-mode condition to correct for.
